title: Replace a paintball permit
summary: You can apply for a replacement paintball permit if your original permit is lost, damaged, stolen, destroyed, or has a printing error.
intro:
If your permit is lost, damaged, stolen, destroyed or issued with a printing error, you can apply for a replacement at a Service NSW Centre or by post.

You can replace the following permits:
who_can_apply: The permit must be lost, damaged, stolen, destroyed, or issued with a printing error.
what_you_need: The 'Replace a paintball permit' PDF form
Proof of identity (such as a driver licence or Australian passport)

how_to_steps.text: Make a payment online and enter your receipt number on the form.
Send the application by email to the details on the form, or visit a service centre to submit in person.

internal_links.text: Change of details for a paintball permit
Apply for a paintball marker permit
Apply for a paintball venue permit
Apply for an international paintball competitor permit

faqs.q: How can I replace a lost or damaged paintball permit?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement at a Service NSW Centre or by post.

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my permit?
faqs.a: You need the 'Replace a paintball permit' PDF form, your permit number (if known), proof of identity (like a driver licence or Australian passport), business details (if applicable), the reason for replacement, and your payment.
Payment methods include PayPal, or a credit or debit card.
